result.instructions: Tools for GreenRope, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the contact for jane@example.com and list the groups she belongs to."; "Which CRM activities are due this week, and for which contacts?"; "Add these three new leads to the 'Webinar 2026' group.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GreenRope data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run greenrope_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run greenrope_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run greenrope_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. greenrope_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: greenrope_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Find contacts by id, email, first or last name, or group. Returns the matching contacts and TotalMatchingContacts. Use start_chunk_page and start_chunk_size to page through large results. XML API: GetContactsRequest.

get_all.description: Ask for all matching contacts (the API's get_all flag).

tools.name: greenrope_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search contacts with a text filter, sort order and page number. Returns the matching contacts and TotalMatchingContacts. XML API: SearchContactsRequest.

from.description: Starting offset, as the API expects it.

filter.description: Text to search for in the contacts.

order_direction.description: Sort direction, as the API expects it (for example ASC or DESC).

tools.name: greenrope_get_contact_groups
tools.title: Get a contact's groups
tools.description: List the groups that one contact belongs to, matched by contact id, email or name. XML API: GetContactGroupsRequest.

tools.name: greenrope_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List contact groups, or one group by id or name. XML API: GetGroupsRequest.

tools.name: greenrope_list_user_defined_fields
tools.title: List user-defined fields
tools.description: List the custom contact fields the account defines, with their types and possible values. XML API: GetUserDefinedFieldsRequest.

updated_timestamp.description: Only fields changed since this timestamp, as the API expects it.

tools.name: greenrope_list_crm_activity_types
tools.title: List CRM activity types
tools.description: List the CRM activity types (labels) that the account can use when it records an activity. XML API: GetCRMActivityTypesRequest.

get_all.description: Ask for all activity types (the API's get_all flag).

tools.name: greenrope_list_crm_activities
tools.title: List CRM activities
tools.description: List CRM activities, such as calls, tasks and notes, filtered by contact, group, type or date range. XML API: GetCRMActivitiesRequest.

due_date_start.description: Earliest due date, as the API expects it.

due_date_end.description: Latest due date, as the API expects it.

done_date_start.description: Earliest done date, as the API expects it.

done_date_end.description: Latest done date, as the API expects it.

get_all.description: Ask for all matching activities (the API's get_all flag).

tools.name: greenrope_add_contacts
tools.title: Add contacts
tools.description: Create one or more contacts (up to 50 per call), each identified by its email address. This writes to the GreenRope contact list. XML API: AddContactsRequest.

contacts.description: The contacts to create. Each needs an email address.

tools.name: greenrope_add_contacts_to_group
tools.title: Add contacts to a group
tools.description: Add existing contacts to a group, by group id or group name. Each contact is given by contact id or email. This changes group membership. XML API: AddContactsToGroupRequest.

group_name.description: Exact name of the group to add to (used when group_id is not given).

email.description: Email address of an existing contact.

contacts.description: The contacts to add. Each needs a contact_id or an email.

tools.name: greenrope_add_crm_activity
tools.title: Add a CRM activity
tools.description: Record one CRM activity (for example a note or a task) against a contact. The activity label must match one from greenrope_list_crm_activity_types. XML API: AddCRMActivitiesRequest.

contact_id.description: The contact the activity belongs to.

date.description: Activity date and time, as yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

due_date.description: Due date, as the API expects it.

prompts.title: Get started with GreenRope
prompts.description: What you can do with GreenRope here, with example requests to try.
